title: Always perform cleanup
summary: A post block can run after the main stages. always is useful for cleanup or reporting whether the run passed or failed.
introduction: A post block can run after the main stages. always is useful for cleanup or reporting whether the run passed or failed. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A post block can run after the main stages. always is useful for cleanup or reporting whether the run passed or failed.
The message appears after the pipeline outcome. Real cleanup should target only resources created by that run.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain why cleanup may still be needed after a failure.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not use a broad delete command as a generic cleanup step.
For more detail later, use this [Jenkins further reading](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/pipeline/).
